page_title: WOL 2-0 HEI | Wolfsburg v Heidenheim 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+5' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Kevin Muller shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
90+2' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

90+2' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
90+1' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Ridle Baku and he is replaced by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
89' 7:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
87' Here comes a substitution. Mattias Svanberg is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg).
86' The cross into the penalty area from Florian Pick (Heidenheim) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Lennard Maloney cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Heidenheim will take a corner kick.

84' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
81' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
81' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
80' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim). Florian Badstubner saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
79' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
76' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
74' A cooling break is underway.
73' Golden chance! Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
72' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
71' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
66' It's time for a substitution. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Lovro Majer.
66' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
66' Vaclav Cerny will be replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
65' CHANCE! Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
65' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
63' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
61' It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
58' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
58' It will be a substitution. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Marvin Pieringer walks off.
57' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
51' The referee blows his whistle, Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
49' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.
48' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Adrian Beck.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
45+5' The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.

45+5' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kevin Muller. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
45+3' A clumsy foul by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
43' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
40' A player from Heidenheim brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolfsburg.
36' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is booked for saying more than Florian Badstubner was willing to tolerate.
35' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
34' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
32' Marnon Busch is being substituted because of an injury. Frank Schmidt sends Omar Traore (Heidenheim) on the pitch.
31' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
29' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' 2 - 0 Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
26' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
23' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
19' Koen Casteels is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Florian Pick (Heidenheim), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
18' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
15' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

13' Koen Casteels makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
13' The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
10' Great teamplay by Heidenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
4' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
3' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half has started.
Heidenheim will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
